registry.name: dropblock2d
registry.description:
Explicit contiguous spatial regularization with per-tensor mask normalization.

    block_size is clipped to H/W, including even spatial extents. Valid top-left
    seed positions spread into exact square blocks. gamma is clipped to one.
    p=1 yields zeros, p=0 and eval return the input. An all-dropped mask yields
    finite zeros. Half-precision mask statistics accumulate in float32.
registry.output_condition: Same shape and dtype; explicit training-only masking.

registry.output_condition: [N,num_classes] unnormalized classification logits.
compatibility: Closed M3 constructor / torchvision adapter; CPU construction only.
Builder v1: linear connections; no external skip/concat/DAG.
BatchNorm requires N*H*W>1 while training; GroupNorm requires valid group statistics.
SE/CBAM keep max(1, channels//reduction); CBAM/ECA kernels must be odd.
Serialization saves architecture only, not trained weights or optimizer state.
common_errors: Use the closed parameter schema described by models show.
